children.generative_objective:
On the All Shares page, click the AAPL stock card.
Enter quantity 100000 in the Buy card and click the Buy button.
Open the Orders page and verify the newest entry shows status "rejected" and the reason "Rejected: insufficient cash".
Then click the "Profile" tab in the corner, open "User Profile Details", and verify the text "Cash: $100,000.00".

approach_reason: Requested to open AAPL, submit a buy order for 100,000 shares, review the order, and view profile details.
Selected AAPL and submitted the buy order for 100,000 shares.
Opened Orders, where the newest order was marked Rejected with the reason “Rejected: insufficient cash.”
Opened User Profile Details and confirmed the displayed cash balance was $100,000.00.
The run finished on the Orders page.
